Hello, everyone!
I'm building a NASA Space Apps 2026 project with SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) data to create real value for communities.
Why join us?
Concept and plan ready
Clear roles, manageable workload
Focus on a working prototype and strong pitch
Open to all experience levels
Who we're looking for:
Strong teamwork and communication
Fluent Portuguese preferred; otherwise, English required
Interest in AI, Data Science, ML, Animation, Graphic Design, or Frontend
